title: Mnesis rar_export_obsidian_vault arguments
description: Published by the Mnesis MCP lane at runtime and captured verbatim; the engine remains authoritative for validation.

vault_root.description: Server-selected vault root; an explicit value must match it

top_entities.description: Number of top entities by frequency to include (default: 250)

max_related_per_node.description: Cap wikilinks per node to avoid hub-of-everything (default: 20)
